title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer with a creative spark and a proven ability to grow organic channels through compelling, multi-format content. This high-impact, hands-on role involves owning the full content lifecycle—from ideation and production to publishing and performance optimization—across written, video, visual, and educational formats.

This is a maker’s role, ideal for someone who thrives on both strategy and execution, and is deeply proficient with modern AI tools and content platforms. You’ll be a key player in our growth marketing efforts, directly contributing to our SEO, CRO, brand visibility, and lead generation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organic Content Channel Growth: Own end-to-end content creation and publishing across blog, YouTube, LinkedIn, and more; continuously optimize content channels based on analytics and business priorities; repurpose and remix content across formats to increase reach and ROI.
  • Video Production: Script, record, edit, and publish original videos in both long-form and short-form formats; create social-ready clips from long-form content using tools like Descript, CapCut, or Premiere Pro; act as the face of the brand in videos, explainers, and live formats.
  • On-Camera & Event Hosting: Host or co-host podcasts, webinars, roundtables, and video interviews; plan and lead live events, from workshops to virtual summits.
  • Visual Content Creation: Design eye-catching visuals like infographics, thumbnails, carousels, and branded graphics; utilize AI tools (e.g., DALL·E, Midjourney) alongside Canva, Photoshop, or Figma for high-quality output.
  • SEO & Web Content: Write SEO-driven blog posts, landing pages, and conversion-focused copy; collaborate with SEO teams to align content structure, keyword usage, and internal linking; perform content audits and optimize pages for performance and clarity.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Improve web content and blog performance via testing and data analysis; refine messaging, layout, and CTAs to drive conversions; analyze competitor content and iterate accordingly.
  • Content Repurposing: Break down long-form assets into emails, graphics, video clips, and social posts; leverage AI tools like ChatGPT to ideate, draft, and repackage content efficiently.
  • Educational & Messaging Content: Collaborate with leadership and sales teams to ensure consistent brand messaging; create course materials, sales enablement content, and thought leadership assets.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years in content marketing or content production with a portfolio of organic channel growth.

  • Expertise in video creation (recording, editing, publishing) with a strong sense of design and color.

description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Atuamos em áreas essenciais como saúde, educação e justiça, sempre com o propósito de transformar serviços públicos por meio da tecnologia. Procuramos profissionais que entendam a importância do sucesso dos nossos clientes públicos, tenham compromisso com a geração de valor e saibam atuar em contextos desafiadores e estratégicos. Se você quer fazer parte de uma operação em plena expansão e contribuir com uma equipe estruturada e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.
  • Equipe de alto nível: Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: Valorizamos diversidade, bem-estar e crescimento profissional.

Benefícios e bem-estar

description:
Sobre a Lemon: as mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Sobre o time de tech: o time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares, responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Estamos em constante evolução e esperamos que você contribua para isso também. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;
  • Ser responsável pelas pipelines de transformação dos dados nas diferentes camadas do nosso ambiente analítico, garantindo a qualidade dos dados entregues;
  • Ser um dos pivôs no aculturamento da empresa em Governança, Qualidade e Confiabilidade de dados;
  • Apoiar e mentorar colegas em práticas de engenharia analítica, ajudando a elevar o nível técnico do time.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Comunicativo, responsivo e didático, com capacidade de traduzir construções técnicas em explicações tangíveis ao negócio;
  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;
  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);
  • Conceitos como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh;
  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;
  • Versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas no uso de esteiras de produtização (CI/CD).

title: Senior Back-End Developer (Desenvolvedor Back-End Sênior)
description:
Company Overview

Dadosfera is transforming the data landscape with a platform that delivers advanced Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities—previously available only to tech giants like Meta, Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft—into the hands of small and medium-sized businesses. By democratizing access to these technologies, we empower our clients to accelerate business opportunities through AI-powered Data Apps.

Our platform minimizes the time spent on cloud management and streamlines the entire data lifecycle—from collection and exploration to processing and interaction—allowing clients to focus on their business goals. Built on a high-growth SaaS model, Dadosfera offers tailored solutions that meet real business needs.

What sets Dadosfera apart is our innovative focus on speed, scalability, and flexibility, combining big data storage with advanced analytics to drive strategic decision-making. Leveraging years of experience with data platform implementations on foreign public clouds, we now deliver a cost-effective, locally adapted solution tailored for both Brazilian and global markets. By blending deep expertise with localized infrastructure, Dadosfera provides a powerful, efficient tool that optimizes corporate data management and drives data-driven transformation.

About the Job

At Dadosfera, we’re building a robust and scalable data platform that empowers organizations to make data-driven decisions with confidence. As a Senior Back-end Engineer , you will play a key role in automating critical product and infrastructure processes—specifically around deployment, billing, usage tracking, and continuous improvements .

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement back-end solutions to support automated deployment workflows, infrastructure improvements, and scalability
  • Develop and maintain automated billing and usage tracking systems in a multi-tenant SaaS environment
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data teams to continuously evolve the architecture of our platform
  • Ensure high code quality through clean code practices, peer reviews, and testing (TDD/CI/CD)
  • Build and manage infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Improve observability, reliability, and security across services
  • Contribute to the definition and documentation of technical standards and best practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software development in production environments
  • Solid experience with Kubernetes (cluster management, Helm charts, troubleshooting)
  • Hands-on with Terraform (module writing, state management, workspaces)
  • Cloud experience with at least one provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) – including IAM and networking
  • Strong understanding of API design (REST or GraphQL), authentication (OAuth, JWT), and versioning
  • Proficient in unit and integration testing, with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Strong knowledge of Clean Code, SOLID principles, DDD, code reviews, and pair programming
  • Comfortable with Docker (image optimization, registry management)
  • Proficient in Git and common branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based)
  • Ability to read technical documentation and write specs in English
  • Experience with SaaS product development (billing, subscriptions, multi-tenancy)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous role as a startup founder or CTO
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
  • Experience in event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, pub/sub)
  • Knowledge of resilient microservice patterns (circuit breaker, retries)
  • Understanding of application security principles (OWASP, network policies, vulnerability scanning)
  • Contributions to open source projects
  • Exposure to data infrastructure tools such as Airflow or Spark, and/or experience with Data & AI platforms

Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences. É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição da vaga

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

RESPONSABILIDADES :

  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem, extração e homogeneização, por exemplo;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores e acompanhar auxiliares e estagiários em procedimentos quando solicitado pelo Coordenador do Setor;

  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Participar de forma supervisionada nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login/Triagem) quanto às amostras em processamento, seguida de impressão de mapa de trabalho. Armazenar essas amostras de forma organizada no setor;
  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;
  • Realizar as tarefas gerais do laboratório de acordo com a divisão de tarefas definidas pelo Coordenador que pode incluir: preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Comunicar a necessidade de materiais e necessidade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, e quando necessário realizar as manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos seguindo as recomendações do fabricante e as orientações do Analista Sênior ou Coordenador;

  • Vistoriar mensalmente os insumos quanto à data de vencimento; informar o Coordenador do Setor com antecedência sobre o vencimento e realizar o descarte quando necessário;
  • Utilizar todos os EPIs necessários para a realização das tarefas com segurança e de acordo com as normas de segurança dos laboratórios;
  • Arquivar documentos de acordo com treinamento da qualidade;
  • Segregar e descartar os resíduos;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade, ou a critério de seu superior.

description:
This range is provided by LawnStarter. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$60,000.00/yr - $70,000.00/yr

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule
  • Unlimited PTO — Focus on results. Take time you need to recharge or work hard when you return

LawnStarter is building the future of outdoor home services. Want to help us shape it?
Apply now and let's grow together.

  • Planning — Analyzing customer requirements for software components, system availability, security, and performance; designing and documenting complete cloud hosting systems, including capacity planning software and instance type selection, allocation, and network design; estimating the costs of the recommended system design; building systems by executing installation, configuration, and testing of cloud resources; using automation and configuration management to ensure repeatability and traceability of changes.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility -our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how thework we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The primary responsibility of the Senior Engineer - Systems Technical Support position is to remotely provide support for server and storage equipment located at customer sites. You will work in the server environment. We ask that you have self-initiative, ownership, a desire to follow issues to resolution, commercial sensitivity, responsiveness, collaboration, and technical expertise.

You will report to the Supervisor Managed Services

Main location: Bogota, Colombia. We can consider other cities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • You will focus on remote managed services for data centers located in manufacturing facilities. Have technical expertise for computer environments and will be instrumental in bridging the industrial and information technology paradigms.
  • You will support modifying and maintaining Windows Server Operating Systems, Active Directory and Directory Services, and performance monitoring techniques on server software and hardware.
  • You will support many VMware products such as vCenter, ESXi versions 6.x+, HorizonView, vSAN and must have experience managing these environments in a production environment.
  • Provide troubleshooting assistance remotely by telephone and email on products to Rockwell Automation field service personnel, distributors, integrators, and customers. Work with other engineers, manage and deal with high pressure situations.
  • Investigate and verify reported product problems in software, firmware, hardware and documentation. Document the problem, work with appropriate group to resolve the problem, and follow up with the Rockwell Automation representative or customer when the problem is solved.
  • Provides documentation of all actions taken in the appropriate systems, set expectations with customers and follow-up on an action item or activity needed to resolve a problem being experienced by a customer. You will update and author Technical Notes and other documentation to inform Rockwell Automation personnel, domestic or international, of solutions to commonly experienced problems, work around, installation practices that create problems to improve customer satisfaction and acceptance.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, computer programming, or similar.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

  • VMWare Certified Professional (VCP).
  • 3 years' experience as a VMware engineer.
  • Proficiency in VMware associated programs and coding languages, such as Windows Server, MS IIS, SAN/vSAN architectures.
  • Knowledge of the fundamentals of VMware solutions and related technologies.
  • Programming Language for cloud platforms: Python, Java, JavaScript, Power Shell
  • Exceptional analytical and technical skills.
  • Availability to resolve urgent VMware environment problems outside of business hours.
  • Familiarity with network and SAN switching technologies.
  • Good English reading, writing and verbal communication skills
  • Strict adherence to company standards and procedures.
  • Excellent trouble shooting skills

  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
  • Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.

  • On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

We believe that employee diversity is an important element of our common future. We provide opportunities for talent growth with the entire organization. Origin is reimagining wealth management by making it accessible and affordable to all.

Our product simplifies finances for individuals making it easy to manage spend and investments, get expert advice, and take action to hit financial goals.

We are a fast-paced startup in the series B round, led by repeat founders and backed by leading VC firms like Founders Fund, Felicis, and General Catalyst.

THE ROLE

Mission

The senior product engineer doesn’t just fulfill that promise but lives by it from the forefront, discovering issues faced by our members and doing whatever it takes to make those problems disappear. They can shape solutions end-to-end; however, they use their experience to collaborate across the board and drive our product thinking forward alongside all her teammates. They thrive amongst uncertainty, leads by example, embeds radical candor , is highly experienced and efficient, and ultimately scales her impact beyond expectations by leveraging all around.

A Typical Day

In this role, every day is an opportunity to impact the technical direction of our company, working alongside a team of equally talented and dedicated professionals. Your contributions will not only drive immediate improvements but also shape our long-term technical strategy.

  • Innovative Development: Your day begins with a focus on advancing our product's capabilities. You'll be building and refining features that directly impact our users, using a mix of established and cutting-edge technologies. This might involve coding, debugging, and deploying updates, ensuring our product remains at the forefront of our industry.
  • Enhancing Software Reliability: A significant part of your role involves delivering software solutions that are not just innovative but also reliable and scalable. This includes reviewing and improving existing code, as well as designing new features with fault tolerance and efficiency in mind.
  • Applying Industry Best Practices: As a senior engineer, you'll continually look for ways to integrate industry best practices into our workflows. This could mean researching new methodologies, adapting them to our unique environment, and sharing your insights with the team.
  • Systematic Problem-Solving: Your expertise will be crucial in systematically enhancing our product's availability. You'll apply distributed systems best practices, identify potential issues, and develop robust solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Collaborative Efforts: Collaboration is key in your role. You'll work closely with other skilled engineers across infrastructure, infosec, and other domains. Together, you'll build a strong technical foundation, setting the stage for our company's growth and innovation in the coming years.
  • Project Leadership: In your role as a senior product engineer, you excel in leading projects from start to finish, working in tandem with engineering managers and product managers to ensure exceptional quality, adherence to deadlines, and effective stakeholder management.

MUST-HAVE

In this Senior Product Engineer role, your expertise and mindset are vital to our success in developing groundbreaking, consumer-facing products in a highly demanding and regulated industry. We are forging paths where others haven't, driven by the necessity of crafting software that is not only flexible and reliable but also capable of rapid evolution without compromising integrity.

Your technical prowess is essential, but equally important are your soft skills and work approach. We are looking for someone who is:

  • Specific Technical Expertise: A strong foundation in technologies like .NET, C#, Terraform, and Kubernetes. Your familiarity with these tools will be essential as they form a significant part of our current tech stack.
  • Intellectually Rigorous: You possess a deep curiosity and a strong desire to explore, understand, and solve complex problems.
  • Relentlessly Resourceful: Inspired by Paul Graham's philosophy , you are someone who thrives in challenging situations and finds innovative solutions even in the face of obstacles.
  • Technically Excellent: Your technical skills are not bound to specific technologies but rather demonstrate a broad and adaptable engineering prowess.
  • Skilled in Feedback: You are adept at giving and receiving feedback, understanding its role in personal and team growth.
  • Effective Remotely: You can work efficiently in a remote setting during an 8-hour day shift while ensuring overlap with our core hours (9 AM to 2 PM PT).
  • English Language Proficiency: Strong fluency in both written and spoken English is essential to ensure clear, effective communication across our global team.
  • Portuguese Language Proficiency: High-level proficiency in written and spoken Portuguese is vital for seamless collaboration and communication within our international environment.

NICE-TO-HAVE

While your core engineering mindset and approach are paramount, additional skills and experiences will be advantageous:

  • Industry Experience: If you have previously worked in regulated, fault-intolerant industries, your insights and experience would be highly valuable.
  • Versatility in Software Development: Experience in developing consumer-facing products, especially in environments requiring high reliability and fault tolerance.
  • Collaborative Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with collaboration and development tools commonly used in remote work environments.

Fulfilling our mission is only possible with a diverse team that breathes for excellence and is hugely committed to making money simple for everyone, everywhere.

As a team, we are obsessed with delivering the best solution possible to our members through an elegant and self-guided experience. We know that building a product of this magnitude requires from us tons of creativity, autonomy, and flexibility to move fast and embrace uncertainties with ownership. This is who we daily pursue to be!

To embrace talented people like this and provide the necessary resources to achieve their best versions, we believe in the power of a healthy environment where each person is valued for who they are and have clear goals and expectations for the future they can build within the company. Each person here is seen as a key player in our team.

Our environment is diverse, with excellent people and equal opportunities. We believe in the power of the individuality and uniqueness of each of us to make our team even more powerful.

title: QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services
description:
QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a QA Engineer Specialist in our BASE area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models. In this role, you will go beyond testing — you will drive quality across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping automation frameworks, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.
As a Q.A. Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of the quality of the most critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the very beginning of the product lifecycle, helping with the product requirements, defining and building comprehensive test scenarios, performing in-depth exploratory testing, and automating mission-critical flows. Your work will ensure backward compatibility, performance, reliability, and overall product excellence.In addition, you will define and continuously improve the testing pipeline, driving best practices in automated testing and mentoring developers to elevate the team’s quality standards.
This role combines strong analytical QA expertise with engineering skills in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from overall test planning to execution.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the design and implementation of test strategies (manual, automated, and exploratory) for complex distributed systems.
  • Define and evolve quality standards, frameworks, and processes across multiple services.
  • Mentor and guide software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership for quality.
  • Partner with product managers and engineering leaders to assess risks, define acceptance criteria, and shape solutions.
  • Drive test automation adoption, building scalable frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Champion performance, load, and reliability testing as part of the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality gates and CI/CD pipelines provide fast, reliable feedback to teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues and propose improvements in architecture, tooling, and processes.
  • Act as a quality advocate, ensuring we deliver not just working software, but trusted and delightful experiences to users.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A QA professional with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in QA Engineering, with a strong background in automation (Cypress, Playwright, Rest-assured, SuperTest, Bruno, Cucumber, Postman, or similar).
  • Experienced with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and data validations in SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Familiar with cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred but not required experience in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, Locust, K6) and their application to large-scale systems.
  • Experienced in risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and working with distributed systems.
  • Solid experience working with distributed systems using asynchronous communication (Kafka)
  • Familiar with SQL, being able to navigate complex data domains
  • Comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, influencing quality practices, and driving alignment on testing strategies.
  • Solid communication skills in English, able to articulate quality goals, trade-offs, and improvements across cultures and geographies.
  • A proactive, collaborative problem-solver who sees quality as a shared responsibility across engineering.
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, NewRelic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana Loki, or similar).
  • Preferred but not required experience with contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, Dredd, or similar).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in QA Engineering, automation test, API testing, and distributed systems using asynchronous communicationare mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

About AlphaSense

Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients' own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team

Expert Insights, encompassing AlphaSense's Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services, delivers transformative market intelligence through unfiltered operator perspectives across thousands of companies. Our library of over 200,000 transcripts is the market's largest, expanding monthly and rapidly becoming essential for institutional investors, banks, consultancies, and large corporations. The Channel & Customer Research team is the newest addition to Expert Insights, collaborating closely with our Directed Content and Expert Call Services groups to deliver structured channel checks and voice-of-customer interviews. These real-time insights illuminate nuanced demand signals, competitive dynamics, customer preferences, and purchasing behaviors across key industries, empowering clients to stay ahead of trends and swiftly adapt strategic decisions.

About the Role

As a Sector Lead for Energy & Industrials, you will bring deep industry subject matter expertise to drive the successful execution of vertical-specific channel and customer research projects. This role provides the opportunity to shape and scale a differentiated research product for Wall Street and corporate clients, setting a new benchmark for actionable insights in the market. Your responsibilities will center around project setup, expert recruitment guidance, rigorous vetting of expert quality and relevance, product quality assurance, feedback loops, and people management. Leveraging your sector-specific expertise, you will guide analysts to consistently deliver high-quality, actionable insights tailored to sophisticated investor and corporate decision-makers. You will mentor analysts, set clear goals, and track performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure accountability and continuous improvement. Additionally, you will play a critical role in maintaining and updating internal knowledge assets to enhance sourcing accuracy and analyst onboarding.

Who You Are

  • You have 5-7 years of experience in buy-side proprietary research, sell-side research, channel-check consulting, or a related industry-specific research role.
  • You have significant experience (4+ years) in the Energy and Industrials sector, with an intimate understanding of cyclical market drivers, commodity pricing dynamics, industrial manufacturing processes, energy production and distribution, sustainability initiatives, and regulatory influences across sectors like oil & gas, agriculture, manufacturing, construction, and transportation.
  • You have strong people management experience, effectively mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts.
  • You are recognized as an industry expert who intuitively understands the nuances, drivers, and key players within your vertical.

  • You possess exceptional analytical and critical-thinking skills and are proficient in leveraging tools like AlphaSense and Tableau.
  • You excel in managing multiple complex projects simultaneously, maintaining high standards of organization, quality, and attention to detail.
  • You maintain a robust understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality requirements, ensuring adherence across all projects.

What You'll Do

  • Define project scope, ensuring alignment with the goals of our channel and customer research offering for your sector, and clearly outlining expert profiles and critical lines of inquiry.
  • Guide analyst teams through expert recruitment, coaching them to consistently source high-value, relevant, and compliant experts.
  • Lead rigorous expert vetting processes, applying deep industry expertise to ensure superior quality and relevance.
  • Implement quality assurance and feedback loops to continuously enhance the quality and impact of research deliverables.
  • Manage analyst teams, setting clear performance goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability.
  • Regularly collaborate with internal stakeholders—including Directors of Research, Product Managers, and Compliance teams—to integrate feedback and drive ongoing improvements.
  • Develop and maintain detailed industry knowledge resources, such as competitive landscapes and buyer personas, to streamline analyst onboarding and improve sourcing accuracy.
  • Document best practices and onboarding processes to mentor and prepare Analysts within the team.

Salary Range

$115,000 - $135,000

Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company. Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Mid-level Software Engineer to join our BASE Focus Area (Tagus team) in Brazil! This is a Remote position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

At the Tagus team, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users, clients, and partners around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.

We have many important challenges such as building a system that gives us the flexibility to have different commercial conditions for different users in different contexts. Also, we are responsible for some critical and important flows within our business model, such as clients\' and users\' subscriptions as well as providing data to the ecosystem as the source of truth of these entities.

When it comes to technical challenges, our team works to provide highly scalable solutions, handling large volumes of data and focusing on high availability. Considering our services central role, you’re going to have the opportunity to help drive architecture decisions that impact our whole microservices ecosystem and you will have opportunities to develop both leadership and technical skills, depending on your career aspirations and abilities.

Your impact

  • Participate in the development of some of the most critical and challenging services in our ecosystem, seeking to build long-term and sustainable solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve services focusing on performance, scalability, and resilience;
  • Build integration with 3rd party API and tools;
  • Support existing systems looking to enhance functionality, increase scale, and transform in new ways to meet our product demands;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritizes people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Work with cutting-edge technologies and edge cases on a global scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who you are

  • An engineer with a bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience;
  • Experienced in architecting large-scale multi-tier web applications;
  • Experienced in designing and developing complex modern web applications;
  • Experienced in Cloud-based architectures (AWS / GCP);
  • Experienced in developing RESTful web services collaborating with front-end teams to create mocks, define payloads and follow the HTTP best practices;
  • Experienced in applying computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithm design, problem-solving, and complexity analysis;
  • Experienced in working with SQL/NoSQL technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB understanding common use cases and performance pitfalls
  • Proficient in one or more programming languages (Java/Ruby/Go/C++/etc.). Golang will be considered a plus;
  • Communication skills to work with multidisciplinary teams located in several countries with different cultures;
  • You need to be able to articulate ideas clearly when speaking to groups in English.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team

What we offer you

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

The Opportunity

Abbott Heart Failure (HF) delivers devices for patients living with heart failure in the areas of hemodynamic monitoring and mechanical circulatory support. Medical affairs of Abbott HF is seeking to hire a director who will join a team of medical specialists dedicated to all medical aspects of safe and effective device heart failure treatment. The director will report to the Chief Medical Officer.

The Director of Medical Affairs will provide daily business operations support related to product development and clinical research, product quality, compliance, commercial/marketing activities and customer interactions. The director assists the Chief Medical Officer in being medical representative of Abbott HF to external regulatory agencies and professional societies.

  • The Medical Director

  • Regionally responsible for Investigator Initiated Study and Research Grant programs
  • Provides input or content to professional education activities
  • Responsible for engaging in and documenting off-label discussions
  • Assists the chief medical officer in KOL and professional society engagement
  • Provides medical input to new product development

Qualifications

An MD is strongly preferred for this role, but a PhD in a relevant area would be considered. A minimum of 5 years of clinical experience including in CV medicine would be required. A minimum of 1-2 industry experience would be preferred. Significant experience with clinical research, including interpretation and presentation would be expected. Strong presentation skills required.

The role is remote. Up to 70 % travel should be expected.

Compensation

The base pay for this position is $168,000.00 – $336,000.00

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen.   • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.

  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships and broad-based understanding around the needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how our AI-powered Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.

  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hours.
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team.
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry.
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company.

title: [Monks] CRM Specialist
description:
Overview

Já pensou em trabalhar na maior agência de marketing digital da América Latina, atuando diretamente com grandes marcas do mercado e tendo a sua carreira e desenvolvimento acelerados através de programas de capacitação em algumas das maiores plataformas de marketing presentes no mercado? Venha fazer parte do nosso time de CRM (Customer Relationship Management)!

A equipe de CRM da Monks está em crescimento e adquirindo projetos maiores e mais desafiadores, expandindo sua capacidade estratégicas nos funis de conversão. Buscamos pessoas que gostam de se desenvolver, tenham aprendizado rápido e capacidade analítica, conseguindo se adaptar à realidade de cada projeto para encontrar as melhores soluções. Nessa oportunidade, você participará ativamente do atendimento de projetos de clientes, tendo suporte para seu desenvolvimento, aprendizado e crescimento de carreira, sem sair de casa, em modelo 100% home office!

O time de CRM é responsável pela diagramação e validação de e-mails responsivos em HTML, configurar disparos em ferramentas de automação de marketing, definir e criar segmentações para envios, além de participar do processo de planejamento estratégico para clientes, criando e fazendo a manutenção de réguas de e-mail. Tudo isso acompanhado da análise de resultados e KPI’s, para apresentação de resultados e sugestões de melhorias nos diversos processos relacionados à área através de relatórios.

Interessante, né? Confira os principais requisitos, responsabilidades e atribuições e se inscreva!

Main responsibilities

É esperado que o perfil trabalhe dentro de um squad multidisciplinar (com suporte de liderança interna de CRM) em contato direto com o cliente, sendo responsável por implementar a estratégia de comunicação de CRM proposta pelo cliente na plataforma de CRM Insider.

Esta implementação compreenderá:

  • Operação da plataforma de CRM Insider utilizando os canais de Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Criação e ajustes de templates de email responsivos em HTML;
  • Criação e manutenção de segmentações para envio, com base nos dados existentes na plataforma de CRM;
  • Criação e agendamento de disparos pontuais de Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Criação e manutenção de réguas / jornadas / fluxos automáticos de comunicação com Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Mensuração de resultados das campanhas, análise de KPIs como taxas de entrega, abertura, cliques e conversão, dentre outras. Capacidade de tirar insights destes resultados para propor melhorias e otimização na operação em andamento;
  • Suporte estratégico junto ao cliente, para identificar pontos que podem ser ajustados e melhorados na estratégia proposta.

Ferramentas e metodologias a serem utilizadas no seu dia a dia:

  • Plataformas de automação de marketing e CRM, tais como Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Hubspot, entre outras;
  • Ferramentas do Google como Sheets, Slides e Docs;
  • Ferramentas de comunicação interna como Slack e Google Chat;
  • Metodologias ágeis.

O que poderá ser aprendido e/ou desenvolvido:

  • Estratégias de CRM e personalização de comunicação com os clientes;
  • Gestão de campanhas de marketing digital e contato com outras áreas correlacionadas;
  • Especialização técnica na plataforma do projeto no qual for alocado.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com operação de plataformas de CRM/Email marketing, tais como Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Hubspot, entre outras;
  • Experiência e proficiência em HTML para e-mails;
  • Conhecimento em Google Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas do Google (Sheets, Apresentações e Docs);
  • Experiência em análise de resultados das campanhas de CRM: Saber analisar KPIs operacionais como taxas de entrega, abertura e cliques, bem como resultados financeiros como taxa de conversão e atingimento de metas;
  • Experiência com campanhas de Inbound e réguas de comunicação (fluxos automáticos de email, SMS, Push, Whatsapp);
  • Independência e autonomia para trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação.

Diferenciais:

  • Inglês fluente ou avançado (ser capaz de ler, escrever, falar e escutar);
  • Experiência em plataforma de CRM Insider;
  • Experiência em estratégias de Whatsapp;
  • Certificações em plataformas de CRM;
  • Conhecimento e proficiência em SQL.

Additional information

O Que Oferecemos

Aqui na Monks, apoiamos e valorizamos nossas pessoas não apenas com excelentes benefícios, mas também priorizando o bem-estar e o desenvolvimento!

Cartão flexível de Vale Refeição e Alimentação;

Plano de saúde;

Plano odontológico;

Flexibilidade de horário e local de trabalho;

Auxílio home office na folha de pagamento (independente se o modelo de trabalho for híbrido ou 100% remoto);

???? Acesso a diversas academias em plataformas;

Day off de aniversário sem descontos salariais;

Licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de 30 dias;

Plataformas de bem-estar e saúde emocional;

Parcerias com instituições de ensino;

Nosso time de Talent Development está pronto para te ajudar na busca pelo conhecimento e desenvolvimento, para que você siga crescendo aqui dentro;

Grupos comunitários para se integrar, trocar experiências e fazer parte dessa cultura incrível.

Esses benefícios podem sofrer alterações no momento da admissão.

LGPD Monks

Nós da Monks colocamos a política de LGPD nos nossos processos seletivos para trazer segurança e transparência sobre as pessoas que estão se candidatando nas vagas para fazer parte da nossa equipe.

Ficou dúvida ou tem interesse em saber mais, basta ler as nossas políticas de privacidade.

Alerta de golpe! - Vagas falsas

Fomos informados que estão utilizando o nome da Monks para divulgar vagas falsas pelo WhatsApp e/ou Telegram. Reforçamos que todas as nossas comunicações realizadas via WhatsApp serão formalizadas via e-mail através da plataforma da Gupy, com os dias e horários que entraremos em contato.

Desconfie de qualquer outra forma de abordagem!

Repudiamos todas e quaisquer tentativas de golpe e ressaltamos a importância de verificar a veracidade das informações fornecidas por qualquer contato antes de compartilhar seus dados pessoais.

Caso seja abordado, não compartilhe informações e entre em contato conosco através de nossos meios de contato oficiais.

title: Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.


Media Buying & Strategy
  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.
Campaign Execution & Management
  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
Budget Management
  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.
Skills & Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote
